name: The Quiet Void
lore_description: Before Planet Kustomazi was created, there was a quiet void. Formless, without shape, teeming with potential, this cosmic abyss was unmoved and aimless, carrying the stories to start worlds.
significance: The primordial state of existence preceding all celestial creation and order.

name: The Sudden Spark
lore_description: A brilliant, sudden flash of celestial light that cut through the darkness of the quiet void, heralding the emergence of the Customizer.
significance: The catalyst event initiating the Genesis of Planet Kustomazi.

name: Kasutamaiza, the Customizer
lore_description: The supreme divine architect who emerged through the primordial spark, capable of shaping raw unformed void essence into living worlds, custom cards, and celestial laws.
significance: The architect and sovereign creator of the entire Kustomazi universe.

name: The Seed of Creation
lore_description: Kasutamaiza gathered the unshaped void into his hands and concentrated its boundless potential into a luminous celestial seed.
significance: The cosmic catalyst from which Planet Kustomazi sprang forth into physical reality.

name: Planet Kustomazi
lore_description: The celestial world sprung forth from the Seed of Creation. A realm of oceans, continents, and golden auroras, forged as the stage for all creation orders.
significance: The foundational world setting of the Land of Kustomazi.

name: The Spellspires
lore_description: The first order founded upon Planet Kustomazi: a guild of brilliant alchemists gifted a piece of the void by Kasutamaiza to study, dissect, and create arcane magic with.
significance: Pioneers of alchemical transmutations and Fusion summoning arts.

name: The Counsel of Time
lore_description: A revered assembly of dimensional manipulators entrusted by Kasutamaiza to govern and balance the phases of time, taught ancient ritual arts.
significance: Guardians of temporal equilibrium and ritual summoning arts.

name: The Teeming Fields of Springtime
lore_description: A lush collective of diverse plant and insect beings created to populate the new world, cultivating flourishing vegetation and ecological vitality.
significance: Cultivators of natural life and ecological swarming on Planet Kustomazi.

name: The Snares
lore_description: A cunning reptilian fiend race guided directly by Kasutamaiza in the tactical arts of trap setting, perimeter defense, and the unyielding enforcement of celestial rule.
significance: Defenders of celestial order and tactical continuous trap disruption.

name: The Hidden Treasures
lore_description: Gem-infused subterranean beasts questing deep within the subterranean mines of Planet Kustomazi to unearth the world's ultimate energy source: The Hidden Treasure.
significance: Excavators of subterranean mineral power and resource energy cores.

name: The LeSpookie Commons & The Dimensional Rift
lore_description: As Planet Kustomazi was forged, the celestial shaping tore a dimensional rift into a whimsical counterworld of Toontastic sights—where lovers of Halloween celebrate the boundary where mortal imagination and supernatural spirits intertwine.
significance: A parallel whimsical counterworld born of the creation rift, governed by Gemini awakening.
